info.title: KarryGo Vendor Service - Section 8 Completion: CRM Loyalty Tiers
info.description:
Vendor-configured loyalty tiers: an ordered ladder of thresholds over the Section 8D loyalty ledger.

A TIER IS DERIVED, NEVER STORED ON THE CUSTOMER. No field anywhere records that a customer is Gold. Standing is computed from the account's lifetime credited points against the current ladder every time it is read, so a reversal, an identity merge or a threshold change is reflected immediately and there is no second copy of the truth to drift. There is deliberately no operation to set a customer's tier: a grant that let a staff member type one in would make every other customer's tier unfalsifiable.

THE INPUT IS LIFETIME CREDITED POINTS, NET OF REVERSED CREDIT - not the current balance. Status recognises what a customer has done over the relationship, so redeeming points must not demote them. Expiry and ordinary redemption move the spendable balance and deliberately do not touch standing.

A TIER CONFERS RECOGNITION, NOT BENEFITS. There is no discount, entitlement, multiplier or monetary field in this contract and there is no benefits engine. Points are not money; payment-wallet-service is the only monetary authority on this platform.

NO_TIER AND NOT_AVAILABLE ARE DIFFERENT ANSWERS. NOT_AVAILABLE means this business has configured no ladder (or the relationship's loyalty account is redacted or merged away); NO_TIER means a ladder exists and this customer has not yet reached its first rung. Neither may be presented as the bottom tier.

tags.name: CRM Loyalty Tiers
tags.description: Definition of the loyalty tier ladder for a business.

get.description: Returns the active ladder in ascending threshold order. A business that has never configured tiers gets an empty set at version 0 rather than a 404 - that this vendor has no tiers is a valid answer to what this vendor's tiers are. The version returned is the one to send back on a write.

put.description:
Atomically replaces the whole ladder. Replacement rather than per-rung editing is deliberate: a ladder is only valid as a set, so an operation that moved one rung would have to either reject most edits or accept a transiently invalid ladder. Every write is therefore a transition between two valid states.

Ranks are DERIVED from the thresholds and must not be supplied; a caller-supplied rank could disagree with its own threshold ordering and the ladder would then have two answers to which tier is higher. Thresholds must be distinct - two rungs at the same entry point make membership ambiguous, and an ambiguous customer-facing status is worse than having no tiers at all. At most 8 tiers.

Superseded rungs are archived, not deleted, so an audit record that referenced a tier keeps something to point at. Segments that read a loyalty field are invalidated in the same transaction, because their materialised membership was computed against the old ladder.

400.description: Malformed request or a missing Idempotency-Key.

409.description: CRM_LOYALTY_TIER_CONFIG_INVALID - the ladder changed since it was loaded.

422.description: CRM_LOYALTY_TIER_CONFIG_INVALID - duplicate key or threshold, bad key format, or more than 8 tiers.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replaying a key returns the first result rather than rewriting the ladder.

minimum_lifetime_points.description: Lifetime credited points, net of reversed credit, at which this rung is reached.

rank.description: Derived from threshold order. 1 is the lowest rung.

tiers.description: Ascending threshold order. Empty when no ladder is configured.

version.description: 0 when no ladder has ever been written. Send this back on a write.

tiers.description: The complete ladder. An empty array removes every tier.

expected_version.description: Omit on a first write; send the read version thereafter so concurrent editors cannot silently overwrite one another.

CustomerLoyaltyTier.description: A relationship's derived standing, as composed into Customer 360. Not separately routable: standing is part of the customer record, not its own resource.

state.description: NOT_AVAILABLE: no ladder configured, or the loyalty account is redacted or merged away. NO_TIER: a ladder exists and this customer has not reached its first rung. Neither is the bottom tier.
